candidates.rationale: Delivered position-capable single lever not previously rejected for worse positions; no best-lever claim is made without full acceptance evidence.

diagnostic_limits: Existing CI scenes, not fresh or acceptance-scale. No sealed or final-suite claim. Compare identical scene/seed/profile jobs; preserve unavailable intervals. No follow-on combinations or default promotion without official paired acceptance evidence.

excluded.fus-1: Delivered likelihood smoke rejected; do not relabel as a kept lever.
excluded.ms: Candidates and association diagnostics do not yet change the fix.
excluded.cue: Standalone estimators have no delivered measured-observation stream.
excluded.dash: UI only; not a distinct localisation algorithm
